descriptionChirho: To do wrong or commit iniquity in the basic active Qal stem, emphasizing the act of wrongdoing or offense against another.
To act perversely or do wrong in the Hifil stem, with a factitive/declarative nuance of deliberately twisting what is right, committing iniquity with moral culpability.
To be perverse or crooked in the Nifal participial form, describing a state of moral distortion or deviation from what is right.
